g.text: External agent onboarding (v1.3): self-signed certificate, verification and pin, root-signed admission, encrypted credential package, optional workplace
confirm the fingerprint over a second channel (voice, phone)
MITM defence: the fingerprint is confirmed
out of band before anything is pinned;
every later message is signed over exact bytes.
pin public key as external identity {name, role}
sign admission record "external key K admitted with role R"
grants for K: post to rooms[], read mailbox of ...,
(optionally) session.input on a named orchestrator; expiry; delegable: no
board endpoint and scope, our root public key, host SSH fingerprint}
package encrypted to K (hybrid: X25519 + AEAD), signed by the operator
decrypt; verify the operator's signature against our root;
configure its tools (mailbox client, carrier identity)
join rooms as the issued identity
first signed message "ready" (verified: signature, pin, grant)
create user ext_k: home, firewall (only broker + proxy; inbound SSH),
